description: A Java entity class representing a Product in an e-commerce catalog, including fields for product ID, merchant store ID, SKU, type, availability, descriptions, and timestamps for creation and update. It uses JPA annotations to define the mapping to the database table 'product'.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity class representing a product with properties such as ID, merchant store ID, SKU, type, availability, descriptions, and timestamps, mapped to the database table 'product'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the product.

methods.name: getMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the merchant store associated with the product.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the merchant store.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU of the product.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the product is available.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of product descriptions.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the product.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the product.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp of the product.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp of the product.
